Synopsis:
    Shell's North American unit is selling its 609 MW Rhode Island gas-fired power complex (RISEC Holdings) to Constellation Energy for $715M, while separately acquiring 100% of Hunlock Creek Generating (169 MW, Pennsylvania). Both moves are strategic plays on surging PJM power demand driven by data center growth. Deals are subject to regulatory approval, expected to close Q1 2027. Shell optimizes its portfolio; Constellation gains a New England foothold in a tight-supply, high-price market.
